comments.text:
People that are hardcore against ai in music don't understand music theory.  They don't understand that music is as much a math as it is art.  Or actually, they probably do understand that, but they don't want the world (average fan) to know how the sausage is made so the people that executives and folks that never actually produce anything can maintain financial control of the industry.  

Ai is so good at producing music because computers are based on numbers and code, just like music is, and ai music will only get better.  I generated 10 songs on Suno last night and literally every one was not just good, but insanely good.  That doesn't mean you can't still write your own music, but ai music doesn't care how anyone feels, and that's why so many of these songs hit so hard.  THEY DON'T CARE and at the end of the day it's about WHAT THE LISTENER WANTS.  THE LISTENER IS THE CLIENT
